name: FAQ
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site FAQ (Webflow component FAQ, built on Relume uui-faq01), matched to the live ahaslides.com AI presentation maker page: a heading over four question rows, each a button that opens its answer with a 0.3s height animation and a plus (no circle) that turns into a minus. Hovering a question with a mouse turns its text and plus or minus Vivid Pink. Several rows can be open at once. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Webflow component FAQ (Pattern / Marketing / FAQ), matched to the live ahaslides.com at 1440px, 768px and 375px
Always on a white background: the FAQ has no Accent background and no background switch
Four editable questions, all closed to start; any number can be open at once
Each row is a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, so Tab, Enter and Space work
Answer opens over 0.3s ease-out and the plus (two bars, no circle) turns into a minus; both stop animating under reduced motion
Hover (real pointers only): the question text and the plus or minus turn Vivid Pink over a short colour transition, on open and closed rows; keyboard focus keeps its ring
Padding tightens at 991px and 479px, the heading and question type step down at 991px and 767px
